title: Design: Credit Terms Log window looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure at least three changes were saved on the Credit Terms page, one of them an edit that changed both the name and the days of a term.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p1-14-credit-terms-log.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" button beside "New Credit Term".
  2. Click "Audit Log".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A wide window opens (as in ct-p1-14-credit-terms-log.png): the bold title "Credit Terms Log" at the left, a search box with a magnifier in the middle and a close × at the right.
  • A table with the headings Event, User, Details, Date and Time on a light-grey band.
  • The newest change on top.
  • The edit row shows its two Details lines one under the other.

Step 3:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R2: “"Audit Log" opens a window titled "Credit Terms Log" with the same layout as the Work Order Log and the Part Sale Log: a search box, then a table with the columns Event, User, Details, Date and Time, newest first.”
  • S12-R3: “Each change saved after release adds one row. There is no Line column. "{rule}" is the term's Due column text (S1-R7). The Event and Details columns read:”
  • S12-R8: “Event, User and Details text is never cut off; long names wrap.”
  • S12-R3 table, edited: “An unused term is edited (Story 3: Create or edit a credit term) | "Credit term edited" | Only what changed: "Name: {old} → {new}" and/or "Due: {old rule} → {new rule}"”
